fields.label: Department
fields.note: greenhouseDepartments tiles link to /about/careers/departments/<slug>.html pages with data-department-filter; no query parameter.

fields.label: Location
fields.note: No location control; values are posted locations for local matching.

notes: The official /about/careers entry redirects to /why-druva/explore/careers and ships the greenhouseDepartments AEM component with data-board-token=druva. It builds department tiles from boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/druva/departments and each tile opens a separate department page; the unfiltered jobs endpoint returns every row. There is no job keyword box (the only search input is the site-wide Algolia search) and no query-param filter on the entry page.
